from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class FinancialLineItem(BaseModel):
    """A financial line item extracted from one company's report."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The company name the report belongs to")
    item_name: str | None = Field(description="The line item name as written in the report, e.g. '信用减值损失'")
    amount: float | None = Field(description="The numerical value of the line item; None if not reported")
    unit: str | None = Field(description="The unit of the amount, e.g. '元' or '人民币元'")
    period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period, e.g. '2024年第一季度'")
    quote: str = Field(description="Verbatim text from the document containing the line item")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    financial_items: list[FinancialLineItem]
